note: First batch of the monthly cadence, extended by a supplementary late-October pass. The 2026-09-01..2026-10-09 pass gave 10,615/736/160/16; the 2026-10-10..2026-10-25 pass gave 3,246/251/58/4 and is merged here. Living tracker for studies published after the 2026-08-31 corpus cut-off; the frozen 141-study corpus is unchanged. One study (Self-Decomposing Diffusion for Code Generation) was recovered manually from the Boolean pass because its efficiency signal sits in the abstract rather than the title. Repository-only deposits remain excluded as grey literature: Wasted Words, Wasted Watts (Zenodo computational notebook), Green Code or Costly Code (Zenodo replication package), and the CFLLM datasets. Output-artifact runtime-efficiency techniques were excluded per the window-round screening rule; boundary benchmarks and measurement studies were retained.
